assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's five curated REVIEWED items at basis_commit: the canonical V2 reconstruction model MHA_SP2_ENDEAVOR_CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MODEL.md (read in full, with the source-labeled Ultra Analysis and Ultra Age claims its EN-SUP-01 to EN-SUP-03 sections admit), and the Endeavor sections of the professional-heroes character-state ledger, the relationship-state ledger, the Japanese vocabulary ledger and the character-model readiness index, each read for every Endeavor entry together with its front matter and current admissibility corrections. All five are repository analysis of the Japanese main manga V01-V42, in which Endeavor's located evidence begins at the V03 evidence gate and V04. The readiness index's specialist_ready label and the model's retrospective probe are inputs, not conclusions. The deep readings the model links, the supplemental reconciliation ledger and audit, the source-reverification audit, other characters' models and any anime or V1 material are not curated on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them; the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Endeavor from the V04:p096-100 and V05:p039-100 successor-project statements, through V06-V07 Hosu, the V13 succession and V18:p131-174 No.1 reflection, the V20:p133-199 and V21:p007-074 Billboard and High-End arc, V25:p132-194 and V26:p013-092 mentorship and the Ending incident, V27-V29 war fronts, the V30:p090-151 Toya broadcast, V31:p096-153 and p201-208 collapse, family coalition and public accountability, V35:p095-170 and V36:p057-119 against AFO, V37:p183-195 and V38:p187-203 convergence with Toya, V39:p007-062 family cooling and differentiated apology, to V42:p057-066 retirement and restitution, with EN-SUP-01 to EN-SUP-03 profile, editorial and author-comment facts as endpoints. Kept as separable states: pre-reform father and elite hero, unwanted No.1 and initial reform, atonement-era mentor, public Toya revelation and war, and V42 retirement; later understanding is not moved earlier. No Endeavor entry covers V08-V09, V11-V12, V14-V17, V19, V23-V24, V32-V34 or V40-V41.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model states an organizing motive (surpass All Might), a feared self (the permanently inferior competitor), the conversion of that failure into a successor project (EN01: V04:p096-100, V05:p087, p098-100), and its later recoding into separable goals: technical work, public trust, keeping young people's futures open and restitution (EN02-EN07). The stable tendency is persistence (俺は…しつこい, V36:p089-103), whose moral direction changes while the trait does not. A repeated decision rule is located: family-triggered crisis produces freeze or solitary burden-taking (V26:p067, V30:p110-115, V31:p096-103, V36:p057-072, V39:p007-020). Not A: EN-V01 found motive supported but action, emotional trajectory and relationship handling only partial, the model names its miss as incomplete relational policy, and the pre-reform household motive is reached through V04-V05 statements and others' accounts rather than his contemporaneous reasoning. Not C: motive, trigger and policy are explicit, state-separated and repeated across V04-V42.

The model separates five snapshots (pre-reform father and elite hero, unwanted No.1 and initial reform, atonement-era mentor, public Toya revelation and war, V42 retirement and restitution). The pro-hero ledger gives dated deltas for V04-V07, V10, V13, V18, V20-V21, V25-V31, V35-V39 and V42, and the readiness index dates each tier change (V04 emerging, V18 moderate, V20 strong, V26 specialist_ready). Knowledge gates are explicit: he believes Toya dead until V30, no Dabi identity claim is admissible in V26, the V21 result is not backfilled into V20 and the V26 curriculum is not moved into V25. Not A: no ledger entry covers V08-V09, V11-V12, V14-V17, V19, V23-V24, V32-V34 or V40-V41; the pre-reform era is retrospective; recovery from the V36 injuries and the retirement state rest on V42:p057-066 plus supplements. Not C: each transition carries located knowledge, capability and relational differences.

Located formulations with speaker and context span proclamatory ambition (そうするべく つくった仔だ, V04:p097-100; ウチの焦凍には オールマイトを超える義務がある and テストベッド, V05:p039-043; やっと俺を受け入れたか!!, 俺の野望, V05:p087; 俺の上位互換, V05:p098), self-obligation (ならば俺も おまえが胸を張れるようなヒーローになろう, V18:p173), public pledge (俺を見ていてくれ, V20:p133-147), internal combat thought (俺の体は 熱が篭り続ける / だからおまえを, V20:p187-195), mentor command (自覚しろ おまえは誰よりも強い力を秘めていると!!, V22:p061; 3人は俺が見る, V25:p190; 並列思考 and 常態化, V26:p017), atonement vocabulary (償う against 許す, V26:p087), stripped self-description (しつこい, V36), future formulation (未来とは若者の進む道だ, V36:p105-119), receptive listening (聞かせてくれ…! もっと…!, V39:p060) and V42 restitution (俺に見てほしかった, 賠償と謝罪, 一生をかけて, V42:p059-065). The model states register rules: 俺, blunt declaratives, compressed commands and comparative vocabulary, a distinct register when he acknowledges responsibility or listens, and addressee-specific apology. Not A: the ledger calls its strings retrieval aids whose glyphs must be rechecked on the page; V31:p208 is given only in English gloss; the V39 differentiated apologies are described, not quoted; there is no address inventory or ordinary-life speech; EN-V01 found speech and register only partial. Not C: more than fifteen located strings cover distinct registers with recipient and state.

Only local, repair-framed ordinary acts are located: the remembered-detail gesture toward Rei (V20:p169-176), the family-table dream and a housing plan that excludes himself (V26:p083-092), the V42 offer of daily conversation (V42:p057-066) and, from supplements, cane use and declined surgery with no stated reason (EN-SUP-02). The supplemental doting-parent jokes are explicitly not admitted as permission or benign parenting (EN-SUP-01). No routine, leisure, household practice or low-stakes social window outside atonement or hero work is analyzed. Not D: no ordinary-life domain is modeled as such.

The model's partner table states conditional behavior and its boundary for All Might, Shoto, Toya, Rei, Natsuo and Fuyumi, and Hawks, sidekicks and students, and the relationship ledger adds located directional states: Shoto (V04:p096-100, V05:p087, V18:p173, V20:p133-199, V22:p060-062, V26:p013-016, V31:p138-141), Natsuo (V20:p169-176, V21:p054-074, V26:p067, p083-092, V42:p057-066), Rei (V20:p169-176, contact still unsafe), Toya (V30:p090-115, V35:p171-187, V36:p057-072, V39:p007-062, V42:p059), Hawks (V20:p133-186, V21:p019-038, V25:p155-171, V36:p057-072), the trio (V25:p132-142, p185-190, V26:p016-030), Midoriya (V30:p150-151) and the public (V31:p201-208). The ledger records plural update rates: Natsuo non-forgiving, Fuyumi connection-seeking, Shoto separating hero and father, Rei's safety boundary governing. Not A: Rei and Fuyumi have few located direct exchanges, the later All Might relation is stated by the model but thinly located, EN-V01 found relationship handling partial, and individual repair is not supplied by the freeze. Not C: partner deltas are located, directional and bounded by what each relation does not license.

Located inner material at several states: the V20:p187-195 internal sequence linking his thermal limit to the successor project, the V26:p083-092 admission that thoughts of Natsuo's future forgiveness entered the rescue moment together with the recurring family-table dream, and the V36 internal correction rejecting rebirth in favor of persistence. The model's regulation section separates early anger, frustration and pressure from later shame, fear, grief and helplessness, and treats his V39 request to hear more hatred as receptive endurance rather than self-condemnation. Not A: pre-reform interiority is inferred from statements and others' accounts, the V31:p096-103 collapse and the V39 death plan are described rather than voiced from inside, and the model says neither technical intelligence nor remorse grants him complete self-knowledge. Not C: inner states are located and tied to decisions at three separated points.

Combat and crisis behavior is located across V06-V07 Hosu, V20:p148-199 and V21:p007-038 High-End (co-produced with Hawks's acceleration), V27:p180 and V28:p100-180 against Shigaraki inside an Erasure-dependent network, V29:p169-175 committing firepower to Bakugo's plan, V36:p057-119 against AFO, and V38:p187-203 where command judges his fire insufficient for Toya's detonation. The model distinguishes well-prepared combat from family-triggered crisis, where he freezes (V26:p067, V30:p110-115) or overidentifies guilt with solitary action (V39:p007-020). Interpersonal conflict with Shoto, Natsuo, Toya and a hostile public is located. Not A: technique and outcome detail are not modeled, pre-reform domestic conflict is reported rather than enacted in this set, and EN-V01 found action partial. Not C: the trigger-dependent split between expert and impaired conduct is repeated and explicit.

The set locates articulated reasons within one ethical domain, accountability and repair: forgiveness against atonement (V26:p083-092, 償う at p087), accepting public scrutiny rather than claiming apology reverses damage (V31:p201-208), rejecting rebirth and suffering as payment (V36:p089-119), keeping adults' past off young people's road (V36:p105-119), receptive responsibility over a solitary death plan after family intervention (V39:p007-062), and restitution without demanding access (V42:p057-066). The model's one conditional reconstruction (V42, an estranged child refuses a meeting but states a practical need) is a high-confidence ethical prediction, with a separate safety judgment reserved. Not A: the pre-reform era shows instrumental reasoning without located deliberation, the V39 change came from others' intervention, not his own deliberation, and civic, political or abstract dilemmas outside family and hero accountability are absent. Not C: reasons are stated, repeated and tied to choices across V26-V42.

No humor or play by Endeavor is analyzed. The supplemental doting-parent jokes are book framing the model resists (EN-SUP-01), not his own play. That limits inference; it says nothing about the character.

A canonical dedicated model with five snapshots, seven evidence atoms, a formal probe and three supplemental sections, plus Endeavor entries in four ledgers spanning V04-V42 with the V03 evidence gate. Not B: no ledger entry covers V08-V09, V11-V12, V14-V17, V19, V23-V24, V32-V34 or V40-V41; the pre-reform household is reached retrospectively; the deep readings the model cites are not curated on this subject; and the readiness index's main missing evidence names motives for the declined procedure and future family outcomes as open. Not D: coverage is dense and continuous across every state the model separates.

Affirmative located limits: professional competence does not acquit family conduct and the sidekicks insist his hero work was not fake while not denying it (V06 delta, V35:p095-109, p155-170); public victory does not synchronize family trust (V21:p054-074); family-triggered operational freezes (V26:p067, V30:p110-115) and Hawks keeping the destabilized father off the Dabi task (V36:p057-072); his fire is the wrong tool for Toya's detonation (V38:p187-203); direct contact with Rei remains unsafe (V20:p169-176); Natsuo ends contact and refuses a marriage introduction (V42:p057-066); and the model's REJECT list (rebirth, equal family blame, entitlement through suffering). Not A: the reason for declining surgery and future family outcomes are open, and pre-reform contradictions between his self-understanding and conduct are inferred rather than located. Not C: several independent limits are located with page and state.

The model and ledgers gate knowledge and capability by state: Toya believed dead until the V30:p090-115 broadcast, no Dabi identity claim in V26, the V20 apparent defeat not backfilled with the V21 result, the V25 benchmark kept apart from the V26 curriculum, later understanding of childhood failure not retrojected into the original harm, and retirement, cane and missing limb as capability states. The model forbids simulating pre-reform command and atonement-era obligation interchangeably, and the V39 youth-to-V42 changes are dated. Not A: the pre-reform era has no dated internal states, and several volumes are unsampled. Not C: each state is bounded by located events and explicit gates.

scenario_readiness.note: The set locates many real formulations across registers and states register rules, but the ledger calls its strings retrieval aids whose glyphs must be rechecked on the page, there is no address inventory or ordinary-life speech, EN-V01 found speech and register partial, and the model says generated dialogue would be illustrative prediction, never attributed quotation. Retrieval of located lines is supported; new lines would be fluent invention. This bounds the evidence set, not Endeavor's actual speech.

conditions: Chronology is one named snapshot, stated explicitly, with his knowledge of Toya, Dabi, the thermal risk and the family's wishes fixed for it; pre-reform command and atonement-era obligation are never simulated interchangeably.

The interlocutor is a family member, Hawks, a sidekick, a trainee or the public, handled as the partner table and relationship ledger give for that snapshot, with no forgiveness, contact or reunion assumed.
The setting is professional command, combat, mentoring, public accountability, family crisis or restitution, with his body state and available support stated before any choice is predicted.

Output describes likely priorities and choices with the model's confidence levels, keeps the family-triggered freeze and solitary burden-taking as live risks, produces no new quoted dialogue as canon and inherits no readiness from the specialist_ready label.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named snapshot, stated explicitly: pre-reform father and elite hero (V04-V07), unwanted No.1 and initial reform (V13-V21), atonement-era mentor (V25-V29), public Toya revelation and war (V30-V39) or V42 retirement and restitution; whether he believes Toya dead, knows Dabi's identity, understands the current thermal risk and knows the family's wishes is fixed for that snapshot, and later understanding is not moved earlier.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Shoto, Natsuo, Fuyumi, Rei, Toya, Hawks, a sidekick, a trainee (Midoriya, Bakugo, Shoto) or the public, in the relation the partner table and relationship ledger give for that snapshot, with each family member's separate injury and boundary preserved.
setting_constraints: Professional command, combat or rescue, mentoring, public accountability, family crisis or restitution
His body state (fire output, overheating, injury, missing limb, retirement and cane) and available support stated
No forgiveness, reunion or family access assumed, and no invented leisure, routine, romance or civic policy

scenario_readiness.note: The model's one conditional reconstruction (V42 Endeavor, an estranged child refuses a meeting but states a practical need: meet the obligation without making access a condition, high confidence from EN07, medium for the arrangement, with a separate safety judgment and an explicit pre-reform contrast) and EN-V01's V38 freeze compared with V39 support narrow novel accountability and crisis scenes. The probe is retrospective and nonblind, with four of five axes partial.

Located ordinary acts are all repair-framed (V20:p169-176, V26:p083-092, V42:p057-066) and the readiness index names unshown family outcomes as open. Low-stakes social life, routine, leisure and retirement daily life are not modeled, so ordinary social scenes would be invention.

conditions: The dilemma concerns responsibility, apology, restitution, forgiveness, public accountability or protecting young people's futures, in a stated snapshot after V18 with his knowledge stated.

Output keeps causal responsibility asymmetric, treats forgiveness and access as the harmed person's to give, rejects suffering or victory as payment, and keeps solitary burden-taking as a risk rather than the resolution.
Pre-reform dilemmas are predicted only as instrumental status reasoning, and abstract civic, political or romantic dilemmas are not predicted.
scenario_readiness.note: Located reasons in V26:p083-092, V31:p201-208, V36:p089-119, V39:p007-062 and V42:p057-066, with the model's PRESERVE, REVISE, REJECT and OPEN rules and its high-confidence V42 reconstruction, support bounded accountability dilemmas.

His marriage is evidenced only as harm: Shoto's account of the Quirk marriage (個性婚) and Rei's trauma (V04:p092-103), contact still unsafe after the V20:p169-176 gesture, a V39 apology and a V42 restitution that does not require access. The model forbids compelling reunion in return for remorse. No romantic conduct is modeled, so a romance scenario would contradict the located boundary rather than extend it.

conditions: The setting is combat, rescue, mentoring trainees, coordinated operations, covert-intelligence reception or public accountability, with the snapshot, his body state and support stated.

Output keeps him a high-capacity node inside a dependency network (Hawks's support, Erasure openings, others' plans) rather than a sufficient solitary answer, and keeps a family trigger as a condition that can impair his judgment.
Exact techniques, combat outcomes and post-retirement aid-program conduct are not predicted.
scenario_readiness.note: Located across Hosu (V06-V07), High-End (V20:p148-199, V21:p007-038), decoding Hawks's warning (V25:p158-171), the trio's training (V25:p132-142, V26:p016-030, 並列思考 at p017), the Shigaraki and Gigantomachia fronts (V28:p100-180, V29:p169-175), the Top 3 team-up (V31:p143-153) and AFO (V36:p057-119). READY was considered and rejected: EN-V01 does not test professional behavior, the family-trigger freeze recurs inside professional scenes, and the V42 aid work rests on supplements, not enacted manga work.

known_limits.statement: Professional excellence and family harm are independent: the sidekicks insist his hero work was not fake without denying his conduct at home (V35:p095-109, p155-170), and public victory does not synchronize family trust (V21:p054-074). Neither may cancel the other in a reconstruction.

A family trigger can freeze or derail the same expert who models extraordinary response speed (V26:p067, V30:p110-115), and Hawks keeps the destabilized father off the Dabi task (V36:p057-072); expert conduct is not predicted unconditionally.
He explicitly rejects becoming a reborn person and does not treat bodily suffering or victory as payment (V36:p089-119); atonement changes the use of persistence, not the existence of the past.

Forgiveness and access belong to the harmed: Natsuo need not forgive (V26:p083-092), Rei's contact boundary governs (V20:p169-176), and Natsuo ends contact and refuses a marriage introduction while Enji continues restitution (V42:p057-066).

His power is not a sufficient answer: High-End is finished with Hawks's acceleration (V21:p019-038), and command judges his fire insufficient for Toya's detonation, which family cooling and Shoto address (V38:p187-203, V39:p007-062).

Supplemental doting-parent jokes, public assistance and professional praise do not establish permission, forgiveness or benign earlier parenting, and the unexplained declined surgery is not self-punishment (EN-SUP-01, EN-SUP-02).
No Endeavor entry covers V08-V09, V11-V12, V14-V17, V19, V23-V24, V32-V34 or V40-V41; the set cannot distinguish absence from non-sampling there.
The pre-reform household is reached through his V04-V05 statements and others' accounts; his contemporaneous private reasoning in that era is not analyzed.
Routine, leisure, retirement daily life, the motive for declining surgery and future family outcomes are not analyzed.

The one formal probe (EN-V01) is retrospective and nonblind, with action, speech, emotional trajectory and relationship handling only partial; no frozen prediction tests teaching, combat or V42 behavior.
